title: Pointer to the properties of the compact-support functors
text:
In the notation of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], the
following holds. That the two constructions above are independent of the
chosen integral representative is
[lem-weil-compact-support-representative-independence], and that the
$\Qlb$-valued construction is independent of the chosen finite coefficient
field is [lem-weil-compact-support-finite-field-independence].
